title: A finite positive-dimensional scheme contains a dimension-one closed subscheme
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with 1 \leq topologicalKrullDim X and topologicalKrullDim X \neq \top [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Then there exist a scheme C [def-pc-scheme] and a closed immersion i : C \to X [def-weil-closed-immersion] such that topologicalKrullDim C = 1.
